description: TS-11 Iskra W1765 (taken on charge 3 Jan 1976) hauled from Hakimpet and displayed beside the hangar approach road at Sonari Airport, Jamshedpur (2014). CAUTION: the bharat-rakshak database now lists W-1765 as ex-Jamshedpur and moved to Bhubaneswar, location there not given; currency at Jamshedpur unverified.
